title: FIPS address derivation compatibility tests
description: Bucket B from docs/plans/fips-spec-update-2026-05-23.md: validate metadesk local FIPS address derivation against current FIPS identity/address rules.
acceptance_criteria: Tests compare md_fips_addr_from_pubkey_hex and md_fips_addr_from_npub against FIPS-derived outputs for representative keys; docs/comments state local derivation is a deterministic fallback, not reachability proof.
close_reason: Added FIPS identity/address-rule vectors and clarified deterministic fallback semantics; focused test passes.

title: FIPS bootstrap readiness and legacy 30078 removal
description: Bucket B from docs/plans/fips-spec-update-2026-05-23.md: update host/client --npub bootstrap to use FIPS daemon readiness/peer readiness instead of metadesk kind 30078 transport adverts.
acceptance_criteria: Client/host check daemon health and bounded peer readiness before md_stream_connect_fips; host no longer publishes FIPS IPv6 as primary reachability; client no longer blocks on on_transport; unconfigured peers fail with clear FIPS config guidance.
close_reason: Implemented FIPS daemon readiness polling and removed primary kind 30078 bootstrap; scoped tests pass. Full meson test reached 25/26 with unrelated a11y timeout.

title: FIPS control client seam
description: Bucket A from docs/plans/fips-spec-update-2026-05-23.md: add a reusable metadesk core FIPS control socket client seam for Linux/macOS.
acceptance_criteria: Control client can discover /run, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, and /tmp control socket paths plus override; issue line-delimited JSON requests such as show_status; parse ok/error responses; expose daemon-unavailable vs daemon-error distinctly; no fips-nat IPC dependency.
close_reason: Implemented FIPS control client seam; focused test passes.

title: FIPS v0.3 migration implementation
description: Implement the migration plan in docs/plans/fips-spec-update-2026-05-23.md: align metadesk with FIPS v0.3.x by using the FIPS daemon for discovery/reachability, deprecating fips-nat, and updating docs/build/runtime expectations.
acceptance_criteria: All child beads are complete; quality gates pass; changes are committed and pushed.

title: FIPS external runtime and gateway documentation
description: Bucket D from docs/plans/fips-spec-update-2026-05-23.md: update README/spec docs to document FIPS daemon as external runtime, Linux+macOS control socket expectations, and fips-gateway as optional Linux-only FIPS-owned infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: Docs explain required current FIPS daemon capabilities, control socket setup, relay/discovery configuration, readiness failures, fips-nat deprecation, Linux+macOS scope, and gateway positioning; no gateway lifecycle ownership is added to metadesk.
close_reason: Updated README/spec docs for external FIPS runtime, readiness failures, fips-nat deprecation, and gateway positioning.

title: Deprecate fips-nat and update build defaults
description: Bucket C from docs/plans/fips-spec-update-2026-05-23.md: move metadesk-owned STUN/punch/TURN/fips-nat out of the supported runtime path and prepare build defaults for deprecation.
acceptance_criteria: fips-nat is marked legacy in docs/help; host startup no longer suggests fips-nat as default fix; kind 30078 NAT JSON is not recommended; build option/defaults prepared to disable fips_nat after replacement path is verified.
close_reason: Deprecated fips-nat path, made build opt-in, updated legacy warnings; clean temp build/test passed.
